title: Graph-based policy compiler and authz middleware adapter for API, runtime, and console
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a graph-oriented policy compiler and a lightweight authorization middleware adapter that serves the API gateway, inference runtime, and admin console. Goals: 1) support expressive RBAC v2 semantics (role hierarchies, attribute predicates, resource scoping), 2) enable fast decision paths with compiled graph indices + TTL cache, 3) produce rich audit events for every admin-level decision (who/what/context) and stream to both internal S3 audit buckets and external SIEM via webhook, and 4) integrate admin SSO/SAML sessions so console decisions include SSO assertion metadata for forensic tracing. Deliverables: policy graph compiler (compile-time transforms + versioning), runtime evaluator library (C++/Rust fast path + Go adapter), authz middleware shim for API/runtime/console, audit enrichment pipeline, migration tool for existing RBAC rules, and rollout plan with canary toggles.
comments: 2025-09-10 - Spec draft uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/RBAC+v2+Graph+Compiler. High-level design approved by Security and Runtime leads in synchronous review.

2025-09-11 - Architecture sync: decided to compile policies into a labeled directed graph (nodes = principals/roles/resources/predicates). Trade-off: increases precomputation time but reduces per-request eval cost by ~4-6x in benchmarks. Need to ensure incremental compile for large rule sets.

2025-09-11 - Review feedback from Product (A. Gomez): require explicit admin 'justification' field surfaced in console and included in audit events when elevated actions are performed. Added to API contract and console mockups.

2025-09-12 - Engineering note: prototype evaluator implemented in Rust with FFI bindings for Go runtime. Micro-benchmarks show median latency 0.6ms for common allow/deny paths; worst-case complex predicate evals can hit ~5ms. We will add short-circuit heuristics and predicate partial evaluation to handle worst-case scenarios.
2025-09-12 - Blocking: SAML assertion schema change required by Identity team to include admin_role_claim. Raised dependency: ENG-61500 (identity: expose admin_role_claim in SAML assertion).

2025-09-12 - Security review required flag set; engaging Security Ops for threat modeling and audit schema review. Plan: redact PII in audit payloads and support configurable retention policies per customer (Dedicated/Private).
